purpose: Literature leads for a comparative regeneration pilot, not an acquired training dataset
notes: Study-level metadata below was extracted from inspected papers. Asset checksums, provider terms, and full sample manifests remain to be audited before ingestion.
Null fields mean not audited or not resolved here, not that an accession or biological property does not exist.
This planning register is not a canonical Genopedia JSONL catalog and is not validated by the protein schema CLI. See regeneration-benchmark.md for the acquisition requirements.

studies.anatomical_context: adult forelimb, homeostasis and early regeneration
studies.suggested_role: candidate within-species pilot, pending sample audit
limitations: Individual cells are nested within animals; split and uncertainty must respect this.
Expression-derived trajectories are not alone lineage proof or human therapeutic evidence.

studies.anatomical_context: tail regeneration; fibroblast and phagocyte programs
studies.assay: single-cell RNA-seq with additional model-specific functional evidence
studies.suggested_role: comparative cartilage and injury-context study after metadata audit
limitations: Tail regrowth is not natural limb regeneration.
Replacement tail anatomy differs from original tail anatomy.
Evidence in lizard context does not establish human benefit.

studies.anatomical_context: nerve cord, control versus 72 hours after arm loss
studies.assay: bulk RNA-seq and de novo transcriptome assembly
studies.reported_biological_units: three animals per group, pooled material; two reported sequencing libraries
studies.accession_verification: reported in inspected paper; provider asset metadata not independently audited
studies.suggested_role: exploratory annotation and comparative retrieval, not a replicated classifier benchmark
limitations: Do not count pooled animals as independent RNA-seq libraries.
Only nerve-cord and one post-injury time point are represented.
Assembly and functional annotations need version and quality audits.

studies.assay: genome assembly and bulk transcriptomic time course
limitations: Brittle stars are not sea stars; keep taxonomy explicit.
Sample pooling, replication, stage matching, and orthology require audit.
Conserved expression dynamics do not prove transferable human regenerative capacity.
